name: Morning hydration
description: Drink a full glass of water before anything else
implementation_intention: When my alarm goes off, I will go straight to the kitchen and drink a glass of water before checking my phone
environment_prompt: Glass of water left on the kitchen counter the night before
reward_description: Enjoy my coffee knowing I've already done something good
temptation_bundle: Only check my phone after finishing the glass

name: Meditate
implementation_intention: When I sit down at my desk each morning, I will close my eyes and breathe for 5 minutes before opening any apps
habit_stack_after: After making coffee, before sitting at my desk
environment_prompt: Meditation cushion placed in front of the desk chair each evening
reward_description: Enjoy a mindful first sip of coffee after the session
temptation_bundle: Only put headphones on for focus music after meditating

name: Go to the gym
implementation_intention: On Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, when I wake up I will put on my gym kit which I packed the night before and leave within 20 minutes
habit_stack_after: After waking up on gym days, before breakfast
environment_prompt: Gym bag packed the night before and placed by the front door
reward_description: Post-workout protein shake and a hot shower
temptation_bundle: Only listen to my favourite podcast while on the treadmill warm-up

name: Read
implementation_intention: After dinner, when I sit on the sofa, I will pick up my book instead of turning on the TV
habit_stack_after: After dinner, before winding down for bed
environment_prompt: Book left on the sofa cushion, TV remote in a drawer
reward_description: Note one interesting idea in my reading log
temptation_bundle: Only make a herbal tea to enjoy while reading

name: Journal
implementation_intention: After brushing my teeth, I will sit at my desk and write three things I am grateful for and one intention for tomorrow
habit_stack_after: After brushing teeth, before getting into bed
environment_prompt: Journal and pen left open on the desk, phone charger on the other side of the room
reward_description: Reading time as a wind-down reward
temptation_bundle: Only allow myself to pick up my phone after I have written at least three lines

name: Walk outside
description: 20-minute walk to get fresh air and movement
implementation_intention: When my lunch break starts, I will put on my shoes and walk outside before eating
habit_stack_after: At the start of lunch break, before eating
environment_prompt: Trainers left by the front door each morning as a visual cue
reward_description: Sit and eat lunch in peace without screens
temptation_bundle: Only listen to an audiobook or podcast while walking

name: No-phone morning
description: Avoid phone for the first 30 minutes after waking
implementation_intention: When my alarm goes off, I will place my phone face-down across the room and not pick it up until I have completed my morning routine
habit_stack_after: Immediately on waking, replacing the urge to scroll
environment_prompt: Phone charger moved to the hallway; analogue alarm clock on the bedside table
reward_description: Check messages guilt-free after morning routine is done
temptation_bundle: Only make coffee once the phone-free window is over

name: Weekly review
description: Review goals, tasks and priorities for the coming week
implementation_intention: Every Sunday at 6pm, I will sit at my desk with a coffee and spend 30 minutes reviewing last week and planning the next
habit_stack_after: After Sunday lunch, before the evening
environment_prompt: Calendar and notebook open on desk on Sunday afternoon
reward_description: Feel prepared and in control heading into the week
temptation_bundle: Only watch Sunday evening TV after the review is done
